title: useCollection
subtitle: Normalized entity lists with per-row resources
description: React hook over createCollection: CRUD for many entities, optional sort, and getResource(id) for independent row drafts.

callouts.title: Local store (alpha)
callouts.content: Collections do not fetch or page from the network. Load with your API, then setAll / addMany. getResource(id).save() writes back into the collection — call your API yourself if you need persistence.

callouts.title: Reset = remount
callouts.content: Config is captured once (useMemo []). Changing getId/sortBy later does nothing. To reset or switch list identity (e.g. workspaceId), remount with React key={workspaceId}.

rows.name: config.getId
rows.description: Stable unique id. Used for Map storage, React keys, and getResource(id).

rows.name: config.sortBy
rows.description: Optional comparator. Re-applied after every write so items stay ordered.

returns.description: Reactive items plus bound CRUD and the underlying collection

properties.name: version
properties.description: Monotonic; drives React re-renders even when status stays ready

properties.name: addOne / addMany
properties.description: Insert entities (upsert by id if already present)

properties.name: setAll
properties.description: Replace entire list; destroys cached row resources

properties.name: updateOne / updateMany
properties.description: Partial or functional update by id

properties.name: removeOne / removeMany / removeAll
properties.description: Delete; destroys that row's cached Resource

properties.name: getResource(id)
properties.description: Cached per-id resource for draft editing; save → updateOne

properties.name: collection
properties.description: Raw API: selectWhere, selectIds, subscribeOne, destroy, …

examples.title: Mental model
examples.description: Normalized Map of entities + ordered ids. Each getResource(id) is its own Resource so two rows can be dirty at once (unlike createResourceHooks).

behavior.title: version drives React
behavior.description: useSyncExternalStore watches collection.version so list UI updates even when status stays "ready".

behavior.title: getResource is cached
behavior.description: Same id returns the same Resource until removeOne/setAll/removeAll/destroy. External entity updates sync via syncSource.

behavior.title: save writes into the collection
behavior.description: Row resource save() calls updateOne(id, draft). It does not hit the network unless you wrap it.

behavior.title: Lifetime = component
behavior.description: Created once per mount; destroy() on unmount. Remount with key to reset.

dos: Remount with key={scopeId} when the list identity changes
Use row.id from the entity (getId) as React list keys
Use useField(getResource(id), path) for inline editors
setAll after fetch; addOne for optimistic local inserts
donts: Don't use createResourceHooks for multi-row editing — one identity only
Don't expect config.getId/sortBy changes to recreate the collection without remount
Don't assume getResource().save() persists to your backend
Don't call getResource for ids not in the collection without handling missing initialData
